# Security policy

DotReticulum is an experimental implementation, not yet suitable for production
or security-critical deployments. Only the latest default-branch code is
currently maintained.

Do not disclose exploitable vulnerabilities, identities, or private keys in
public issues. Use GitHub's **Security > Report a vulnerability** private
reporting feature for this repository:
https://github.com/dennispayne/DotReticulum/security/advisories/new

If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository maintainer through
their GitHub profile to arrange a private channel before sending details.
Include affected revisions, reproduction steps, impact, and a proposed fix if
available. Do not include real credentials or third-party private information.
Maintainers will coordinate disclosure after assessing the report and preparing
a fix; response timelines are not guaranteed.
